1.title: A Hostile Trump Reopens Old Wounds in the U.S.-Canada Relationship
1.summary: President Trump is not the first American president to feud with Canada. But today’s crisis might be the worst.

2.title: Trump Is Delayed After Emergency Slide Deploys on New Air Force One
2.summary: The mishap occurred while the Qatari-donated jet was parked on the tarmac at Joint Base Andrews. It delayed President Trump’s departure to a Republican convention in Dallas.

3.title: James Talarico Counters Trump’s Midterm Convention With Food Drive
3.summary: The Democratic Senate candidate used a food drive to sharpen his economic message against Ken Paxton.

4.title: Spanish intelligence warned of Ceuta mass crossing plans before surge
4.summary: Declassified documents show Spanish and Moroccan authorities were alerted to social media calls for a mass migrant crossing the day before tens of thousands entered Ceuta.

5.title: Yemen Tilts Toward Full-Scale War as Saudi-Houthi Clashes Escalate
5.summary: With its oil-export routes once again under threat, Saudi Arabia is stepping up its military campaign against an old antagonist.

6.title: Iran referred to UN Security Council for nuclear non-compliance
6.summary: Tehran condemns the resolution, blaming US and Israeli strikes on its nuclear facilities for disrupting inspections.
